#fightclub #Fight #boxing 
👹SASQUATCH'S BACKYARD👹

Streetbeefs Scrapyard holds Monthly fights in our location of Gig Harbor Washington, sign up on facebook. Sign up, show up, get matched up, FIGHT!
Hosted by - Firechicken

Links Below
INSTAGRAM: / https://www.instagram.com/streetbeefs_scrapyard/
FACEBOOK: / https://www.facebook.com/groups/StreetbeefsScrapyard
TIKTOK: / https://www.tiktok.com/@scrapyard_official
Firechicken's INSTAGRAM: / https://www.instagram.com/fir3chick3n/

LinkTree-https://linktr.ee/streetbeefsscrapyard

Sponsors-
Peixotto - https://www.peixotto.com 
HKA USA - https://hkausa.com/
https://www.Sasquatchthelegend.com 

Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2Tr7vqNAg32eozqAuElfZQ/join

Alternate angle channel - https://www.youtube.com/@ScrapyardFightsPNW
Email - Scrapyardfighting@gmail.com
Facebook group- https://www.facebook.com/groups/StreetbeefsScrapyard
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/streetbeefs_scrapyard/

ALL STUNTS AND MATCHES ARE FILMED IN A CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENT WITH SAFETY BEING THE MOST IMPORTANT FACTOR.

No Money involved. Pay or charging. We arent open to the public for spectating. email me if you have a reason you want to come out. 

Join this channel to get early access to the fights before they release to the public! 

DO YOU WANT TO FIGHT??? join our Facebook or IG and contact us. OR email us 

OUR MATCHES ARE 100% LEGAL. ALL PARTICIPANTS MUST BE 18 OR OLDER. Welcome to the Scrapyard! We are a LEGAL backyard Fight organization Located in the Pacific Northwest. The Scrapyard was created in 2020 by "Firechicken", a former Amateur MMA fighter, Wrestling coach, and Boxer. The Scrapyard holds monthly fights in our Pacific northwest location. No money is involved in any way, we do not pay fighters or charge any sort of admission to our events. We aim to give people a place to start their combat sports journey, meet people, solve beefs, or just test out their abilities. 

All sign ups are done on our facebook group only

ALL SCRAPYARD MATCHES ARE AMATEUR EXHIBITIONS

description: Two beautiful souls, one govern by his Soul, Hasanti (KenDon Tillis), an aspiring Spoken Wordsmith, and one govern by her Heart, Na'Eemah (Ariel Simone), a Senior Publicist and aspiring Mentor, share a slight connection after a meeting at a Los Angeles Nightclub. title: Chalk N Duster
description: CHALK N DUSTER is an emotional journey of two teachers Vidya ( Shabana Azmi) & Jyoti ( Juhi Chawla) , serving at a Mumbai - based High School. Their passion and love for teaching, bonds them in a special relationship with their students. Their gratification is good grades, moral values they strive to impart to students.However, in an evil turn of events, a wicked lady, Kamini Gupta ( Divya Dutta) gets appointed as the School Principal, who earlier worked in the capacity of a Supervisor. She is extremely cunning by nature and monopolizes on every opportunity she can find her hands on. In a bid to make profits for the school, she decides to fire experienced teachers to replace them with fresher teachers. The saved funds of which she can boastfully present to the school trustees, at the cost of quality education. Vidya suffers a sudden heart attack due to her dismissal from school. The school management threatens the staff to cut ties with Vidya. At such a time, Jyoti stands up for her friend and colleague, Vidya. Together they fight to earn their respect and credibility as teachers and unite against prejudices set by the management.

title: Porkchop 'n Flatscreen!

title: Dine n' Dashians

title: Flesh 'n' Blood
description: Adoptee Rachel, a successful DA, searches for her birth family and locates a redneck brother Arlo. title: Guns 'n' Moses
description: A day in the life of the Jewish settlement of Hebron, the tomb of Abraham and the stronghold of the Israeli religious right.A polyphonic tale of spirituality and violence. Guns'n'Moses is a documentary about the Israeli ultra nationalist-religious settlers and their ideology in their own words . Their accounts interweave to create a fabric in which stand up their concepts of time and space, their idea of identity and enemy, the Divine plan underlying the daily life and the same use of the violence. Modern prophets carrying assault rifles, hippies devoted to the Cabala and the American folk music, techno-dancers longing for the Redemption and mothers proud to raise the future soldiers of the Messiah. In their own word and through their own eyes.

title: Dom n° 8
description: The developmentally disabled children at Home No. 8 in Gorna Banya are rehearsing a musical-gymnastic number to celebrate June 1st, the International Day of the Child. The theme of the celebration is "Peace on Earth." During the course of their endless practice sessions, an obvious conflict arises between the their caregivers' rather absurd notions of peace and happiness and actual everyday life in the care home. By the end, one of the children has reached 18 years of age and in accordance with the rules must be moved to a new home: Home No. 6.

title: Mzungu (n.) White-Wanderer
description: This feature length documentary, Mzungu, is our story about personal change, sacrifice, adventure, and ultimately the power of love and community. You will embark on a journey into the great joys and perils of Africa through the eyes of four-young-naive and unassuming Americans. As we join Scott, Eric, Dan, and Adam on their crusade to 'save the world', you too may just fall in-love with Uganda and Rwanda, meet some new friends, and change your life for the better. These young men aren't on a vacation, they have gone to work hard, to 'help', doing what they know best. They will visit Internally Displaced People camps and witness the short and long term effects of genocide and tribal wars. They gain a new understanding of the immense devastation HIV/AIDS is creating across the continent of Africa.. But in the course of making life- long friends, as well as, facing the loss of life, the viewer is on this journey as well. We hope you will also laugh, cry, sing, dance, and in the end leave Africa completely different people. In a time when social entrepreneurs and global issues rule the media, this documentary is a truly raw and real look into a once-in-a-lifetime journey that turns into an entire world of friends working together. The power of this film lies in the questions it forces us to ask ourselves. Are we doing enough, what if it's too hard to help people, what does it mean to love people we've never met? Yet, in the end, you too will may start to believe the world can be a better place and that it is up to you to change it!

title: Romeo n' Juliet
description: Only one will survive. This is their story. William Shakespeare's immortal tragedy 'Romeo and Juliet' has remained vital through five centuries, and is now reborn and blooms in contemporary, post-Soviet Latvia. 25 years have already passed since Latvia regained its independence from the Soviet Union, yet it's facing urgent issues in the present day - two ethnic groups are living in separate communities, thus dividing one country in two. Shakespeare's play has never lost its urgency, proving its greatness in terms of genre and message. Now, "Romeo n' Juliet" depicts the contemporary love story of a young Latvian girl, Juliet, and a Russian guy, Romeo.

description: When well-known writer Jacques Rynhardt disappears, it is up to a journalist to unravel the mystery. To do that, she needs to go back to his childhood and get to know Jacques for who he was.

title: Rize N Grind
description: Every Emcee has a story, this is theirs.

title: Arby 'n' the Chief
description: This show follows the adventures of two halo toys' lives. One is a dimwitted Halo 2 Master Chief action figure and the other is a brilliant and skilled video game player who is a Halo 2 Arbiter action figure. They go from battling hackers to battling each other during their wacky mishaps. Watch and enjoy this universally, critically acclaimed show that has swept the nation.

title: Reel: Hard 'N' Heavy Schwermetall, Der Film
Les chroniques de l'île du roi boiteux (n°1: Pâques. n°2: Les enfants du serpent)
description: A documentary in two parts on magic in the Philippines, shot in the witchcraft island of Siquijor. First part: Easter: Easter season's sorcerers' magic potions, curses and healing. Second part: Children of the serpent: The magical power given by the snake to the peasants shamans.

title: O Snehurce
description: Sixth-grade pupil Katka daydreams during a maths class about being Snow White and being freed by a prince who looks very much like Dzery from the eighth grade. Katka, her girl friends Lenka and Martina, and her fellow-pupils Franta, Joska and freckled Vrabcák, have spent five years going to the same little one-class school in their home mountain village of Pastvina. Their kind teacher Smetácek was very understanding about their games and fantasies, but he didn't teach them much about arithmetic. They are now laughed at for their ignorance by the strict Bidlo, their new teacher at the near-by little town. As he does every year, Smetácek is preparing a theatre performance with the local children. Katka suggests the fairytale about Snow White.

title: O Coronel e o Lobisomem
description: In the beginning of the Twentieth Century, Coronel Ponciano de Azeredo Furtado inherits the farm Sobradinho in the country, many possessions and the title of "colonel" of his grandfather. His close friend Pernambuco Nogueira, son of one of the employees of the farm and with whom Ponciano was raised together since they were born, gets nothing in the will. Ponciano has a crush on his cuisine Esmeraldina, but he never declares his love to her. When he loses the mortgage of his farm to Nogueira, who got married to Esmeraldina, Ponciano goes to the court trying to prove that Nogueira is a werewolf.

title: O paramythas
description: A cheery ground attendant decides to impersonate his cousin who is a successful pilot to impress a beautiful nouveau-riche socialite; however, his fiancée uncovers his shameless shenanigans. Can he keep both his future wife and his job?

title: O babas mou, o teddyboys
description: Two poor friends pose as rich and flirt with two women in a hotel.

title: O Kadin
description: The love story of a model who is betrayed by her fiance and a doctor who saves her from depression.

title: O Parto Que Destruiu o Chefão
description: Grávida de nove meses, Alessia é mantida em cativeiro pelo próprio marido, Vito Falcone, que a obriga a adiar o parto para garantir que o filho da viúva de seu irmão nasça primeiro e herde o território da família. Ignorando seus apelos e colocando a vida da esposa e do bebê em risco, Vito escolhe proteger a outra mulher. Quando finalmente decide libertá-la, já é tarde demais: Alessia e o filho desapareceram, deixando-o diante das consequências irreversíveis de sua traição.

title: O Guarani
description: The love affair between Ceci, a white woman and a handsome Indian, Peri, in Brazil.

title: O Grão
description: The elderly Perpétua, feeling the approach of death, decides to prepare Zeca, her beloved grandson, to the inevitable. She tells him the story of a king and a queen, a wealthy and powerful couple who lost their only child but wishes to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Damião e Josefa work hard to support their family and to prepare their daughter Fátima's wedding. At the end, the tale told by Perpétua and the destiny of that family will cross.

title: The Great Cleric [Hindi]
description: Earth's God of Destiny lost to Galdardia's Chief God for a bet and chose ten souls to hand over. Galdardia's Chief God handed those ten souls new vessels. Among those souls was Luciel, a salaryman, who fought against his destiny of death.

title: O Desejado
description: João is the spiritual heir (the term he prefers to bastard) of Manuel Brandão, his dying godfather, and at the same time the political leader of a small party of a disintegrating governmental coalition.

title: O Tronco
description: A tax collector is sent to a small region where he starts to differ with the unusual way of the local to exercise power.

title: O Teos kai o Stavros
description: In the island of Syros, his place of residence, filmmaker Stavros Kaplanidis meets writer Teos Romvos. The two of them have come a long way together: schoolmates, Paris in the years of the military junta, in the alternative culture hangouts, Exarchia in the Metapolitefsi years... A life's sum up that etches the joint portrait of two free-spirited artists of anarchist ideology, who were never pinned down on labels both in life and in the arts they loyally served.

title: O polyteknos
description: With three daughters, a wife, his sister, and a meddling mother-in-law living under the same roof, a hard-working coffee-shop waiter who yearns for a son, instead, becomes the proud father of three more girls. Will his wish ever come true?

title: O angelos mou o diavolos mou
O Sakaflias
description: 1935. Giorgos Sakaflias has the reputation of the toughest man of Trikala. He loves the beautiful but poor Lenio, while the rich Nora wants him. Nakas, who wants Lenio his own, will blame Sakaflias for the murder of Smyrnia's prostitute. Nora, too, when she does not succumb to her appetites, will blame him for rape. Sakaflias will leave from Trikala. The police will ring him and start looking for him.

title: Daddy O Baby O
description:
In this restored and remastered film, Mario (Dolphy) has to fulfill a promise made to his dying friend- take on the role of a father to a very mischievous girl, Ana (Serena Dalrymple). Released in 2000 and directed by Eric Quizon.

Starring Dolphy, Serena Dalrymple, Angel Aquino, Angelica Panganiban, and Gloria Romero.

title: O Touro
description: A Portuguese girl arrives at the Lencois Island, in Brazil, curious about this new place surrounded by huge white sand dunes. Its residents are all descendants of King Don Sebastian, who disappeared in the 16th Century.

title: O Papa que Venceu o Comunismo
description: When a cardinal who had been considered harmless by the Soviet Union is elected Pope, he initiates a spiritual revolution that challenges and destabilizes communism, culminating in the fall of an empire.

title: O Fascínio
description: O FASCÍNIO is an intriguing story about a family and a manor house (where some terrible crimes were committed in the past by a member of that family) adapted from a novel with the same title by Tabajara Ruas.

title: Ter o Céu, Pagar o Inferno
description: Kíria, a Imortal do Kirin, recebeu um favor do Senhor Lima. Em troca, deu-lhe uma joia do desejo. Anos depois, o filho dele, Henrique usou a joia para pedir um filho. Kíria transformou-a numa Pérola da Concepção e, com seu poder, fez Helena, a mulher dele, engravidar de um menino. Henrique venerava Kíria, mas Helena, pensando que ela era uma filha ilegítima do marido, virou-se contra ela.

title: O gabros mou, o dikigoros!
description: A barber wants to marry his daughter to a scientist. He believes that he has found the proper candidate in the face of a trainee lawyer.

title: O Aprendiz
description: This is the Brazilian Version of the TV show The Apprentice where the contestants compete in this reality show. There are a total of 8 seasons. The 3rd Season the prize was a contract with WPP Group, the largest advertising group of the world in New York working for Wunderman NY. The 4th season of the Brazilian version of the show The Apprentice with a twist, instead an employee a partner for a company will be chosen. As a reward for winning the show they visit Anselmo Martini, winner of the Aprendiz 3 and also the Blue Sky studios.

title: O-Town
description: The story of a small town as told from a mysterious filmmaker's point of view. O-town is the town of his birth, and Peace, a two-bit hustler is at the center of all that has gone wrong with the town. The mysterious filmmaker has a near omnipresent overview of the pimps, the scam artists, and the drug dealers as they ravage the moral backbone of a town wholly subjugated by a sadistic and suavely mannered gangster, simply known as The Chairman... but not for much longer.

title: O Mineiro e o Queijo
description: Poetic and political account of the tradition handed down from generation to generation for over 200 years for the production of artisan cheese in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil.

title: O paragyios mou, o rallistas
description: Manolis, who works in the coffee house of Agisilaos, complains to his mother that he gets very tired at work, but she gets into trouble when she realizes that her son's boss is flirting with her.

title: Daddy O, Baby O!
description: Middle-aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a turnaround when his dying friend Arnold makes him promise to take care of his daughter Anna. But Anna is not an ordinary little girl. Despite her angelic look, she's mischievous and in search of her estranged mother.

title: O Outro
description: The plot revolves around two men with great physical similarity: the wealthy businessman Paulo Della Santa and the scrapyard owner Denizard de Mattos.

title: O anakatosouras
description: A string of bizarrely improbable coincidences upset the balance in the orderly life of a meek employee, as the sudden appearance of a self-confident doppelgänger leads his family to false assumptions. But, who is this mysterious "other"?

title: O Segredo
description: O Segredo

title: O Lamparina
description: After being deceived by a small time crook with a promise of a job for his family, Bernardino Jabá (Amácio Mazzaropi), his wife Marcolina Jabá (Geny Prado), their two sons, their daughter and their Spanish friend are mistaken as being "cangaceiros" (bandits from the Northeastern of Brazil). They help the police to arrest the outlaws, but Bernardino Jabá misses and is considered dead. When he returns to the small village one year later, the locals believe that it is his soul indeed.

title: O Abajour
description:
O Abajour é a história de Guilherme (interpretado pelo ator Alex Reis). Um rapaz que conquista um padrão de vida invejável... Mora em um sofisticado apartamento no Leblon, bairro nobre da Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro, namora a filha de um advogado conceituado e de bastante prestígio na sociedade carioca. Guilherme gosta de freqüentar os melhores lugares, usa roupas e acessórios de marca e é para as pessoas uma referência de "bom moço", pela maneira gentil e atenciosa com que trata os amigos e com quem se relaciona, mas por trás de todas essas qualidades ele esconde um segredo que lhe pode custar muito caro.

Guilherme trabalha como "Abajour" um tipo de informante X9 da polícia corrupta do Rio e descobre que seu amigo de infância e viciado em drogas "Murilo" (interpretado pelo ator Daniel Bouzas), está endividado com um "agiota" barra pesada chamado "Moby" (interpretado pelo ator Daniel Braga).

Mesmo resistindo no início, Guilherme acaba se comovendo com o desespero do amigo e resolve ajudá-lo. A partir daí, os dois seguem em busca de uma solução, mas eles tem pouco tempo e muitos obstáculos a serem superados. Tudo isso pode dar muito errado e os dois amigos podem estar mais encrencados do que pensam.



 "O Abajour" is the story of Guilherme (played by Alex Reis). A young man that attains an enviable lifestyle... He lives in a sophisticated apartment in Leblon, an exclusive neighborhood in the South Zone of Rio de Janeiro, dates the daughter of a prestigious lawyer in the "carioca" high society. Guilherme enjoys the finer things in life, the best clothes, nightclubs, and is known by everyone as a "nice guy". But behind all these qualities lies a secret that can cost him everything.

Guilherme makes a living as an "abajour" (lit. a "lamp" which is a term used for a kind of informer for the corrupt police in Rio de Janeiro) and he finds out his childhood friend and drug-addict Murilo (played by Daniel Bouzas) owes a large amount of money to a dangerous loan shark named Moby (played by Daniel Braga).

Resisting at first, Guilherme ends up feeling moved by the plight of his friend and decides to help him. From that point they strike out to find a solution, but they have little time and many obstacles to surpass.

All of this might go very wrong and the two friends may be in much more trouble than they suspect.

title: O Bolão
description: Dominated by his mother-in-law, man working at a record store dreams of winning a popular lottery. There are others with the same dream: a tourist agent, a man working at a gas-station and a couple whose relationship turned sour and can't stand each other's presence any longer. Some of them do win, and break up with everything around them: relatives, bosses, lifestyles... only to find later that the prize must be shared with thousands of other winners.

title: O Maaeri
description: "O Maaeri" is a deeply moving cinematic experience that delves into the themes of emotional resilience, family dynamics, and the unbreakable strength of women. Journey of a mother and daughter as they navigate trauma, betrayal, and hope.

title: O pappous mou o Papaflessas
description: A tender look at the hero of the Greek Revolution of 1821. Papaflessas traveled to Constantinople in the age of enlightenment and romanticism, and became a member of the revolutionary organization "Filiki Eteria" (Society of Friends), taking on the task of inciting his compatriots against the Ottoman Empire. What sets the heroes apart? Can their mistakes be justified?

title: O Clube
description: This project aims shed light on the Goa and Tanzania links through the stories, memories, objects and places that testify the deep connection between the two shores of the Indian Ocean.

title: O nikitis
description: The story of a young man's fall into the trap of drugs and his power of will that made him quit during his army duty time.

title: O Patouhas
description: A free-spirited herder, raised in the rugged mountains of Turkish-occupied Crete, reluctantly leaves his sheep pen to visit his father in the village and finds true love.

title: O maharagias
description: A poor man accepts some money to impersonate a maharaja who has canceled his stay at a luxurious hotel.

title: O Porteiro
description: Waldisney works as a doorman in a chaotic building. However, he is an excellent at keeping order. When he is wrongly accused of stealing something, he has to prove that he is anything but a thief.

title: O misogynis
description: A recently fired cook poses as a misogynist to get a job in the mansion of an unrepentant woman-hater.

title: O boufos
description: An incorruptible civil engineer finds himself between a rock and a hard place when his wife presses him to accept a lucrative proposition, and his boss wants to approve his plans. Will he renounce his principles, and yield to temptation?

title: O emiris kai o kakomoiris
description: An Arab monarch arrives in Athens accompanied by his wife and his beautiful daughter, who falls in love with a charming background actor. Of course, the princess is unaware of his innocent ruse. What will happen when the truth comes out?

title: O Cumpagn' Mi
description: Mirko Valentino watches the match of his great friend and colleague Clemente Russo at the Rio de Janeiro Olympics and, suddenly, he cries because he knows how is going to end. Contrary to his expectations, Mirko himself didn't qualify for the Olympics. He had hoped that at least his friend would be able to bring home a medal. After the defeat in the qualifying match, Mirko gained 15 kgs in two months, the symptoms of depression had clearly manifested. When Clemente returns in defeat from Rio, he is destroyed. He has an ungroomed beard and is dead behind the eyes. They have kissed the canvas. But they will have to get back up and fight again.

title: O-Negative
description: A doctor forces his daughter's boyfriend to help him find and kill unsuspecting victims in search of that one with O-Negative blood that will save the daughters life.

title: O arhilistarhos
description: The life, action, and death of the brigand Fotis Yiagoulas, whose head (next to the ones of his comrades Babanis and Tsamitras) was hanged at the train station of the city of Katerini, in September 1925. Yiagoulas was a controversial persona, accused of 54 murders. Following his execution, the era of brigandage in Greece comes to an end.

title: O Cravo e a Rosa o documentário
description: 60 Years career of actors Rosamaria Murtinho and Mauro Mendonça in the history of Brazilian Theatre, Film and Television.

title: O drapetis
description: In early 1950s Athens, an idealist shadow player, after forty years of dedicated work, witnesses the end of an era and the demise of his once popular art with the arrival of cinema.

title: O Seqüestro
description: A robber breaks into a house in the Santa Teresa district of Rio de Janeiro and kidnaps the family's youngest son. Based on a true kidnapping that happened in Rio de Janeiro in the 1970s, whose victim, Carlinhos, has never been found to this day.

title: P
description: Whilst growing up in rural Thailand, a young orphan girl is taught the ways of magic by her grandmother. But when grandmother falls sick, Dau is lured to Bangkok to find work so that she can buy medicine. She finds herself working in a go-go bar, and her journey from naiveté to maturity is swift. She uses the magical skills her grandmother taught her to her advantage, but in doing so makes enemies within the bar. As her magic gets darker, and the consequences increasingly horrific, she gradually loses control, and something evil takes over.

title: The Miracle of P. Tinto
description: Wafer factory-owner P. Tinto and his wife Olivia want a their own child more than anything else in the world, but after years of trying, they have nothing but a pair of extraterrestrial midgets living in their spare bedroom. title: Paglipay
description: The film focuses on Atan, an Aeta from Baytan village in Zambales, the Philippines, who makes a living from traditional farming system kaingin and hunting on the foothills of Mt. Pinatubo. The narrative opens as we follow Atan's fulfillment of his arranged marriage with a fellow Aeta, Ani. He has to accomplish a number of responsibilities which includes the offering of bandi or bride price to Ani's parents. Atan needs to cross the mountain river going to Banwa, the town where he could earn the necessary amount for the bride price. In order to find a job, he needs to adapt himself with the modern way of life in town, including change in appearance, manner of clothing, religious practice, and even the use of different language in order to associate himself with the Unat or 'straight-haired ones,' such as Rain, a young lass from Manila who would turn his life around. Meanwhile, Rain has to immerse with the Aetas of Banwa for her thesis, and Atan is commissioned to accompany her in research and interviews with the locals. Atan develops special feelings with Rain in his daily encounters with her. Slowly, the young Aeta forgets the very reason of his journey-the bandi, and the arrangement with Ani. In his effort to accommodate himself in a modern society, Atan faces cross-cultural modifications amid changes in the mountain brought about by immense modernity. Note: Paglipay is a Sambal Ayta term being used by Aetas when crossing the mountain river going to town.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

#ShowtimeLaroTogether
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Miss Q&A
description:
To start the month of October, nagpasiklab sa "It's Showtime" stage ang six-member Japanese dance and vocal boy band na Be:First. Sa unang araw ng Oktubre, entertainment ay libre at sagot 'yan ng mga beki na palaban sa "Miss Q and A." Walang aatrasan sa talakan sina Jouji Medina, Jane Estolora, at Ayesa Pido Quilang.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, sakto sa BER months, 'Santa Claus 'scamming' to town' daw ang bagay na kanta para kay Jouji at sa jowa nito dahil parang hindi tugma ang mga kuwento. Si Jane naman, very Barbie ang awrahan kaya pinarampa ni Meme sa harapan. Action star na nag-transition naman ang dating ni Ayesa sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, at ang boses daw nito para bang tunog tsismosa.

Araw ito nina Ayesa at Jouji dahil sila ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Nag-loading man nang bahagya, naitawid pa rin ni Jane ang talak sa tanong na, "Saan dadaan si Santa Claus kung wala namang chimineya sa bahay n'yo?" Hindi naman sa nagmamaasim pero palaban ang chukchak ni Jouji sa tanong na, "Ikagagalit ba ng sinigang na mas maasim ka sa kan'ya?"

Ang totoong naasiman, si hurado Brent Manalo, dahil sa joke ng kaibigan niyang escort, Ralph de Leon. Pinakitaan pa niya si Ralph kung paano bumitaw ng pangmalakasang joke. Naging escort of the day rin si Darren Espanto, and true to his branding, ang mga jokes ni Darren idinaan sa singing.

Sa tiangge, dapat marunong tumawad. Dapat din naka-smile lang ang nagbebenta par ng swerte ay pumasok na. Kaya sa Laro Laro Pick, sold out ang good vibes at may sukli pang jackpot para sa mga players na tindera.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Alona, na halatang-halata ang saya nang makita nang personal si Vice Ganda. Pero maya-maya, si Meme Vice kinabahan. 'Yung tingin daw kasi ni Alona, parang may bulong.

No return, no exchange, sabi nila. Pero si palyer Maye, naka-return sa game arena matapos mabunot ang pangalan niya. Naniniwala siyang kalooban ng Panginoon ang paglalaro niya sa jackpot round kung saan umabot na sa P400,000 ang POT money.

Nag-goodbye si Maye sa P40,000 Li-Pot offer at sinugalan ang katanungan na may kinalaman sa 13th month pay ng isang private employee. Higit pa nga sa 13th month pay ang biyayang dumating kay Maye dahil nasungkit nito ang POT question!

title: HUGOT sa Miss Q&A
description:
Bumisita ang bandang Teeth para sa isang masayang rakrakan! At kahit certified rockers ang peg, bigla namang lumambot ang kanilang galawan nang sumabak sila sa trending “Meme” dance challenge—from rakrakan to dance cuties real quick!

Rated 5/5 stars ang talak ng mga acclang rumeresbak sa Miss Q and A Resbakulawan. Hot and fierce ang arrive nina Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Rocky Cueva, at Jhon Vincent Cahulogan, na pare-parehong grateful sa second chance na sumalang sa chukchakan.

Pagkatapos ng hayop sa galing na three-way face-off, ang Top 2 na sina Jhon Vincent at Heaven ang umabante sa Beklamation kung saan napahugot naman sila sa tanong na, "May nagmamahal bang bumibitaw?"

Pati hosts at hurados, naglabas ng saloobin. Kapag talaga si Brent Manalo ang nagsabi, ramdam ang hugot at pighati. Hindi naman sinasadyang masagi ang sugat ng nakaraan ni Ryan Bang.

At para bang déjà vu from her Breaking Muse days, Verna Periwinkle flaunted her confidence anew. Bakit daw matatakot bumitaw ang katulad niyang binibining marikit kung marami naman ang naaakit? Well, napa-sorry na lang si Marina Summers dahil hindi tulad ni Verna, wala siyang reserba.

Hospitality Management students ang nagdala ng campus energy sa Laro Laro Pick! Nakilala natin si Jibi, na mahilig sa vlogging at nagbigay pa ng sample ng kanyang bartending skills na bahagi ng kanyang kurso. Ipinagmamalaki naman ni AJ ang kanyang sipag sa academics bilang isang Dean’s Lister.

Pero sa dami ng challenges, si Mahly ang umusbong na Top 1 ng batch at tuluyang umabante sa Jackpot Round, kung saan P350,000 ang pwede niyang maiuwi. Hindi natakot si Mahly na sumugal para sa P350,000 POT money.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Napa-KEMBOT at napa-OOOH LA LA na ang buong bayan kaya may bagong assignment sa sayawan. Ihanda ang bewang at ang energy para sa todong galawan dahil sa bagong dance craze na sinimulan ng Showtime Baby Dolls. Bagong kanta nila titled "Meme" ang bagong sasabayan sa sayawan!

Kapag wit at talakan ang subject, mga accla ay valedictorian. Kaya deserve koronahan. Sina Jemzian Seco, Kea Marie Kipling, at Josh De Leon ang sumabak sa Miss Q and A examination kung saan kailangan nilang mapahanga ang buong nation sa pagsagot sa mga playtime questions.

Kahit napagod sa biyahe na tumagal dahil sa baha, laban pa rin si Jemzian. Si Kea naman ay isang optometrist na Rank 7 sa board exam. At pinatunayan nga niya ang pagiging brainy nang mapa-wow niya si Vice Ganda dahil hindi pa man tapos basahin ang tanong ay agad siyang nakasagot—complete with a full explanation!

Sina Kea at Jemzian ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At para bang meant to be ang nabunot na tanong ni Kea, “Kung isa kang optometrist, anong ia-advise mo sa pasyente kapag sinabi niyang malabo ang kanyang third eye?”

Pero mas meant to be ang korona kay Jemzian, na tumatak sa mga hurado at Madang People dahil sa nagkandaligaw-ligaw niyang sagot sa tanong na, “Anong mas masakit? Bigyan ka ng mag-asawang sampal o sampalin ka ng mag-asawa?”

Mapa-araw o gabi, sila ang tagabantay ng safety. Sila ang mga hardworking security guards mula Pasig City.

Inspirasyon ni Koriks ang limang anak. Kaya para sa kanilang pag-aaral, willing siyang sumugal para sa ₱200,000 POT money. Kinumbinsi naman siya nina Brent Manalo, Ralph de Leon, at ng Baby Dolls na kunin ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer sa pamamagitan ng dance number.

Pero sa huli, pinakinggan ni Koriks ang gusto ng anak na subukan ang POT question. Dahil gusto ni Meme Vice na masayang umuwi si Koriks, binigyan niya ito ng sampung libo.

title: Miss Q&A 3rd Weekly Finals
description:
Matutuloy na ang pagkikita ng dalawang icons ng noontime at komedya, 'Meme' Vice Ganda at 'Bossing' Vic Sotto. Samantala, mga Miss Q and A weekly finalists ang ka-date mo, at siguradong ma-i-in love ka sa mga talak nilang spot-on at matatalino. Unang tapak pa lang sa entablado, agad agad ay ready to slay and give their best sina Bb. Talinghaga, Rhain Boyonon, Mama Dhel, Jers Sabado, Raux Araneta, at Agua Gonzales.

Nasubok ang kaalaman ng ladies sa mga tanong na may kinalaman sa mga sangay ng gobyerno. Sina Mama Dhel at Rhaine ang 'chumukchak' sa final round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, "Sinong mas matalino? Ikaw o AI?"

Matalino ang sagot ni Rhain, na itinanghal na Miss Q&A TalakiTalk of the week!

Ang kabataan na masipag at may pangarap sa buhay, siguradong magtatagumpay. Mga estudyang kumukuha ng vocational courses, sumugal sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Enjoy ang kuwentuhan with Dagul, na ipinagmamalaki ang skills sa carpentry. Isinabuhay naman ni Dominick ang salitang versatility dahil sa dami ng talent na entry.

Pinaghandaan naman ng It's Showtime hosts act-song entries nila sa You Gotta Lyric round. May moment ang DaCkie tandem nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. At sina at MC at Lassy, bagay rin ba na maging mag-jowa?

Pito ang naka-survive sa It's Giving, pero isa lang ang nakapasa sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay si Ced. Pangarap niya, magkaroon ng malaking ambag sa pamilya. At ito na nga 'yun! Naniniwala siyang malaking ambag na ang P20,000 kaya tinanggap ni Ced ang nasabing Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A Arah at Jhong, binalikan ang pagkikita nila noon
description:
Para bang inatake ng mga langgam ang buong studio dahil sa sweetness nina Bianca De Vera at Dustin Yu, na sa tinginan pa lang ay walang sinabi ang tikoy sa sobrang lagkit. Ano nga ba ang pinakakilig na ginagawa nila sa isa't isa? Kung si Dustin ay kinikilig sa luto ni Bianca, si Bianca naman ay solb na ang kilig sa ngiti pa lang ni Dustin.

Nag-hello ang mga reyna na ready to claim the korona sa Miss Q and A. Meet Anora Laforteza ng Pampanga, Ian Torres ng Manila, at Arah David ng Taguig. Baon nila ay wit na super big at personality na kaibig-ibig.

Pati si Jhong Hilario ay hindi nakaiwas sa charisma ng fangirl na si Arah. Lotlot man siya sa kompetisyon, feeling winner pa rin si Arah dahil sa moments nila ni Kuys Jhong. Samantala, 'may bitaw' ang talak nina Ian at Anora as they faced their respective questions sa Wit Lang round.

Nabunot ni Ian ang tanong na, "Sino ang mas badtrip kainuman, 'yung tumatakas o 'yung natutulog?" As a kanin lover, napangiti si Anora sa nabunot niyang tanong, "Ano ang mas bad trip? Walang ulam o walang sinaing?"

Parang tumatawag ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kaya napasugod ang mga taga-Parang, Marikina.

Agad bumuhos ang emosyon sa laro dahil sa life story ni player Kalbo, na tinitiis ang pagod at hirap para tulungan ang mga pamangkin sa kanilang mga pangarap. Samantala, si Darren Espanto, humingi ng space kay Jackie Gonzaga. Our DaCkie hearts! Huhu! Pero mabuti na lang aktingan lang 'to!

Sa pagtitinda ng prutas itinataguyod ni Eka at ng mister niya ang pamilya. Dito sa Laro Laro Pick, wish niya sana'y magbunga nang magandang biyaya ang kanyang pagpili kung tatanggapin ang Li-Pot offer o susugalan ang tanong para sa POT money.

#ShowtimeAyunLaruuu

title: Harapang HEAVEN at NADIMUNYO sa Miss Q&A
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

title: Marina Summers bilang hurado sa Miss Q and A
description:
Sabi nila, may darating na someone, someday, 'yung kapag nakita mo siya parang laging may background music ang paligid. Kapit lang, dahil minsan dumarating 'yan nang biglaan. Habang hinihintay ang pagdating ng pag-ibig, heto na si Mr. Randomantic James Reid, handang magpakilig!

Lahat sa mundo may halaga, mula sa mga kulisap hanggang bulaklak sa hardin at mga puno (please huwag naman natin silang putulin). Sa Miss Q and A, boses ng mga kandidata ay may halaga at aral na puwedeng pulutin.

Huwag 'inaancha' ang mga kandidata dahil hindi sila basta-basta. May maipagmamalaking talento, talino at puso sina Summer Rejane Corpuz, Wilson The Buss, at Jomaima Johnson na nagpagalingan sa talakan.

Hot na hot talaga ang puksaan with special guest hurado Marina Summers. Present pa rin si Nicole Cordoves, with Ralph de Leon. Sina Wilson The Buss at Jomaima ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Parehobg bumoses, pero sa korona, isa lang ang sumakses! Si Jomaima ang wagi bilang Miss Q&A Reyna Talakers of the day.

Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Tonsuya, Malabon sa game arena.

Pagdating ng You Gotta Lyric round, si Dalag ang only player na naka-survive! Baka pampaalis ng kaba, nakipa-playtime si Dalag sa mga trip ni Vice Ganda hanggang sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000 ay kanyang tinanggap.

title: MC at Lassy hindi nagpakabog sa Miss Q&A stage
description:
Hindi suspended ang good vibes dito sa "It's Showtime" dahil tuloy-tuloy lang ang buhos ng tawanan at happiness. Parang Signal No. 4 ang intensity ng biritan sa FUNanghalian handog nina "TNT Duets" 2 champs Christian Tibayan at Arvery Lagoring.

Pati ang "Ohhh Lala Baby," naging mapanakit! Pero kung duet lang naman ang usapan, lalaban ang pares nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto aka DaCkie d'yan! Eh, magpapakabog ba naman ang BreCkie?! Si Brent Manalo, nag-warm up pa, sabay 'da move' na siguradong kikiligin ka Dong digi digi dong! Aha!

Heto, may bago! Ralph de Leon at Lassy aka RalphSy! Hirit ni Lassy, kung siya ang pinili ni Ralph papunta sa kanyang puso, siguradong may papaldo!

Sa "Miss Q and A," kapag hindi alam ang sagot, you've got to shoot your shot, bes! Sabay ngiti at sabi ng, "And, I thank you!" Malakas ang arrive nina candidates JV Zeped, Audrey Zunega, at Carla Shuvee Medalla, na sa bawat hampas ng balakang sa pagrampa, ika'y mapapa-ohhh lala.

Sa "Wit Lang" kung saan sina Carla at Audrey ang nagharapan, nabunot ni Carla ang tanong na, "Payag ka kung passenger princess ka pero nakasabit ka?" Ang tanong naman kay Audrey, "Payag ka masarap ka magmahal pero wala kang panlasa?"

Mag-manicure ay 'di biro, maghapong nakayuko sa pagkuskos ng kuko. Kaya deserve ng mga madlang manikurista players ang isang masayang bonding at laro sa game arena.

It's giving girl power si nanay Lisa sa Laro Laro Pick. Ikinuwento niya ang hirap at sarap ng pagiging isang solo parent ngayong graduate na ang mga anak sa kolehiyo. Paldo naman sa kilig si Jelai dahil kay Vhong Navarro. At sa sobrang kilig, naligaw pa ang 'I love you' na para kay mister!

Ang naglaro sa jackpot, si Bhels, na 35 years nang itinataguyod ang pamilya sa pamamagitan ng mani-pedi. Kaya naman super deserve ni nanay ang P25,000 Li-Pot offer, na malaking ginhawa na para sa kan'yang pamilya.

title: NAPAGOD SIYA! Miss Q&A Barbie, nag-request ng timeout
description:
May mga oras na sa'yong pag-iisa, mapapatanong ka na lang ng, 'Ba't hanggang ngayon?' Ayun! May mga bagay talaga na mahirap kalimutang kahit lumipas na ang panahon. Parang feelings kay ex na ibinalik ka sa kahapon. Parang mga kanta R&B Queen Kyla, na hindi naluluma. Manunumbalik ang sakit kapag narinig mo ang live version niya ng "Hanggang Ngayon." 

Napa-YOLO ang mga kandidata sa "Miss Q and A.” Dahil once in a lifetime lang ang chance na tumuntong sa entablado, hindi na sila nagdalawang-isip na tumodo. Sa June 19 episode, nag-PAK-siklaban sa rampahan at sagutan sina Andrea Jane Peralta ng Quezon City, Andrea E. ng Pampanga, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Cavite. 

Pak na pak ang tawanan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round dahil sa nakakalokang sagot ng mga kandidata. Ano ba ang Ingles ng 'batok'? Sagot nila, neck, neck-neck, at back-neck! Ayun, walang korek! Sa hinaba-haba man ng laban, dalawang Reyna Talak-Era ang kinoronahan! It’s a tie!

Kilala ang lugar nila bilang 'Marching Band Capital.' Nagmartsa papuntang 'Laro Laro Pick' ang mga taga-Bacoor, Cavite. Nagsama-sama ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. All-star cast! Si Vice Ganda, para bang napagkaisahan, napagtawanan at tinawag na 'kabayo' ni Vhong Navarro. Pati si Ion Perez, naki-asar sa kanyang 'misis.'

Heartbreaker naman ang special role ni Brent Manalo. Teka, 'di ba aktingan lang 'to? Bakit si Jackie Gonzaga ay parang na-hurt nang totoo? Aray mo! Sabi kasi ni Brent, "Hindi kita bet!" Aww, Ate Girl! Sakit?! 

Ang daming nangyayari sa Showtime family, na sobrang kukulit! Kaya si Meme, humirit, pwede bang pa-extend ng air time kahit mga five minutes?!

Extended ang all-out na saya sa jackPOT round, kung saan naglaro si player Virgie, isang caregiver. Tinanggap niya ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng P250,000 POT question. Tama ba ang kanyang desisyon?

#ShowtimeTalakEra
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Vice, ‘PINAGALITAN’ si Lola Move sa Miss Q&A
description:
Pagkatapos ng weekend na makulimlim at maulan, sa wakas ay sumilip na ang haring araw. Parang sunshine, nagpasikat din si Tawag Ng Tanghalan The School Showdown champ at ex-PBB Collab 2.0 housemate Carmelle Collado with her hot na hot na talento.

Pero ano 'tong 'bigay' ni Vice Ganda. Si Carmelle, may pinananabikan na "kamao?" Ahhh, kamao ni Anton Vinzon pala! Eh, 'yung kamao ni Darren Espanto, diretso akbay kay Jackie Gonzaga.

Ang kanilang mga beauty at personality na naghatid ng laughter, certified pang-main character. Good vibes ay solb kasama sina AZ Sasaki, Mitch Anne Lorenzo y Parizcova, at Lola Move.

Hindi pa man tumatalak, feeling winner na si AZ sa halik ng 'oppa' na kanyang kinakikiligan, si Ryan Bang! At kung ang choreographer na si Mitch ay super groove, hindi naman nagpakabog si Lola Move.

Kung ang talak ng isang lola ay may dalang wisdom, ang talak naman ni Candidate No. 3 ay may dalang katatawanan. Lahat ng gusto ng Madlang People ay kanyang gagawin, mapa-interpretative dancing tapos sa floor ay may pa-rolling, o ala Ogie Diaz workshop na acting. Pero walang biased sa edad dito, dahil kahit lola ay 'napagalitan' ni Vice Ganda, muntik pang ma-olats dahil bida-bida?

Bida nga talaga si Lola dahil sa Tumpak Ganern round siya ang frst to slay, at sinundan naman ni AZ. Time to face-off sa Wit Lang! Wala nang waiting pa, dahil agad-agad kung kumuda ang dalawang kandidata.

Hindi mumunti, kundi malaki ang swerteng dumapo sa mga residente ng Poblacion, Muntinlupa City na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, sa July 13 episode ng “It’s Showtime.”

Inspiration para sa buong nation ang ibinahagi ni Bel, ang loving mommy na pilit nilalakasan ang loob sa kalagayan ng anak na nagka-mild stroke sa edad na 6. Mahirap man ang laban ng buhay, nand'yan naman si hubby na kanyang kaagapay.

Pero hindi rin nawawala ang pag-e-enjoy. Si hubby, basketball ang hilig at paboritong player si... Michael V? Ay, Michael Jackson! Parehong mali! Kaya para sa sakyan ang trip ng mister ni Bel, kanya-kanyang pabida ng MJ moves ang "It's Showtime" family.

Michael Jackson na Gen Z ba kamo? Sagot 'yan ni Darren Espanto! Nakakatunaw naman sa kilig ang version ng MJ moves ni Brent Manalo, at ang kay Ralph de Leon ay pang-judo. Napalaban si Ralph at para bang napadasal nang muntik siyang matumba habang binubuhat si Ogie Alcasid. Laugh trip! Solid!

Solid din ang aktingan sa You Gotta Lyric round. Aktingan lang 'to, pero 'yung hurt ni Lassy parang totoo. Sagot kasi ng player sa eksena niya, "Mabaho!"

Nangamoy swerte ang jackpot round kasama si player Edmar, isang store crew, na tawang-tawa sa trip nina Vice Ganda. Nonchalant and shy lang siya no'ng una pero lumabas ang magandang ngiti nang mapag-usapan ang pangarap para sa mga supling.

title: You're Hired!
description:
After the "mysterious" death of a colleague, the doldrums of office life at DanRick Designs are given a surprise resuscitation when Miles Fuller and Dylan Kirkpatrick discover they are the lead candidates for a promotion. The timing of the advancement opportunity couldn't be more ideal for the entry-level employees. The Tech Center where Miles' voluntarily teaches inner city teens is low on funds, and Dylan is desperate to purchase the home his deceased father built by hand, before his mother is manipulated by his weasel stepdad to put it on the market. The pay increase from the promotion could resolve their dilemmas, except only one of them can win the job.

Peers and family deceive the young men into believing racial disparities always impact office politics, so assertive, yet questionable actions, may be necessary to level the playing field if they really want the job. Is ethical compromise justified for a moral cause? Miles and Dylan will journey down a rabbit hole that not only answers the question, but drops them in the middle of chaos and high jinks so wild, staying alive becomes more vital than the job!

With a colorful cast (literally) of quirky characters, You're Hired, explores both internal and external perceptions and struggles of race and identity. This social satire avoids political correctness, opting to poke fun at the ignorance and insecurities that create unnecessary division. Sometimes laughing at stereotypes is simply wiser than allowing them validity, especially in today's America.

title: My s Vulkanom
description: A story about a boy, who saved a puppy from hooligans and raised him as a border dog. According to the author of the story, "the most pure and original in a person is associated with childhood. And wisdom, intelligence, depth of feeling, fidelity to duty and many other wonderful qualities of an adult never conflict with the precious stock of childhood."

title: Mis(s)Communication
description: Fleeing her pageant career in disgrace, plucky diva Imogen stumbles upon a new career as a standardized patient, an actor for medical students. But life outside the spotlight proves harder than she thought.

title: Décrochage(s)
description: Sénart MicroLycée is a french college for students who have not terminated their college course. The goal is to bring those students up to Baccalaureat, using a very peculiar pedagogy.

title: Galaxy Angel S
description: Galaxy Angel special that contains 2 stories. During an infiltration of the Angels' base, Milfeulle grabs a grenade and runs off with it, sacrificing herself to save her friends. Later on, she wakes up, believing it all to have been a dream. Things seem off when Commander Volcott and the others can not see or hear her. Realizing she is now a ghost, Milfeulle must come to terms with memories of her friends, both good and bad. Commanders Mary and Volcott have been ordered to switch commands. Neither is very happy with the situation, but they make do. That is, until the Twin-star boys insult Commander Volcott's mustache. Enraged, he reverts to his old army self, the "White Supernova Wolf". The Angels try desperately to control their former leader while Mary sneaks off for some tea.

title: Léto s kovbojem
description: A young psychologist Doubravka (Daniela Kolárová) swimming in a pool meets Honza Machácek (Jaromír Hanzlík) who summers co-op cows nearby. Honza likes the racy girl at the first sight and his directness imposes on Doubravka too. They start to date. Honza comes from a big family, he was degraded to a cowboy when he had a tractor accident caused by alcohol and lost his driving license. In the summer cabin, Doubravka takes care of Bobo (Oldrich Vízner) - a student of medicine who prepares for an one exam for the third time. He is selfish and in his uncertainty he behaves to Doubravka uninterestedly and outrageously. Honza supposes Doubravka looks after a crazy person, yet soon he learns that Bobo is Doubravka's boy-friend. On the other hand, Doubravka finds a girl's name tattooed on Honza's arm and troubles come.

title: Malchanie s dostoynstvo
description: Silence with Dignity is a documentary about the life and work of the famous Bulgarian film directors, the family of Irina Aktasheva and Hristo Piskov. It is a story about their emblematic films and of those whose realization was banned, the criteria according to which a film was classified as "too dangerous" under communism, the mechanisms of censorship, their persistence and creative survival and their silence charged with dignity. The film reveals unknown details of the history of Bulgarian cinema and the link between the political elite and the intellectuals at the time.

title: S dnem rozhdeniya, Lola!
description: The film's heroine, Lola, is getting ready for the celebration of her birthday. Because she knows she is in for a surprise, she lets two strangers with flowers and a cake into her apartment. The ?guests'? names are Bim and Bom; they are killers. They've chosen the girl's apartment as a shooting place to assassinate the president whose motorcade is to proceed by her house. Lola becomes a hostage and? the main obstacle foiling the assassination plan. First comic strip film in Russia.

title: Portret s dozhdyom
description: Misfortune brings a lonely and middle-aged sailor to Claudia, who came to his house to help bury his mother and take care of him in the first difficult days after the funeral. Anatoly at first sees only calculation in her actions. But gradually the hero begins to realize that he is deeply wrong.

title: Chelovek s bulvara Kaputsinok
description: The first years of the XXI century. Masha Fest, the granddaughter of Johnny Fest, is coming to Russia. And what turns out? Much has changed over a hundred years, but the main thing has remained unchanged: the love of money and art can work miracles, and the love of cinema is miracles in the square. Masha finds herself in Russia with a grandiose goal - to make a Good Clean Soulful movie, a movie with a human face. She has money - the collector brings it. But as soon as local crooks find out about the amount, they prefer to rob it and cheat.

title: The Good Sh*t
description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

title: 100% T-Shirt
description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

title: Bushirt T-shirt
description: In the world of the Pandyas, chaos is the norm and laughter is the solution to every problem. Just as the name suggests, 'Bushirt T-shirt' highlights two diverse ideologies between parents and their children along with the drama and emotions that follow. In an unexpected series of events, the Pandya's navigate their way through comic twists and entertaining turns in their quest to overcome their differences.

title: Uncle T
description: When carefree bachelor Fred T gets a visit from his military sister. He is asked to watch her kids, which are his niece and nephew due to her being deployed. Now he must adjust to his new living style and maintain his single lifestyle.

title: Big-T Explores the Galaxy
description: Join Big T the super-smart T-Rex as he goes on quest for knowledge in this educational film for all ages. Ride along on the journey of a lifetime as Big-T Explores The Galaxy.

title: Jeans and T-shirt
description: Nino works as an ice cream seller on the Italian island of Capri, where he falls in love with a young woman with a rich and disapproving father.

title: Sandy Burke of the U-Bar-U
description: After Sandy Burke rescues orphaned seven-year-old Dolly Morgan from Jim Diggs, who gunned down her father, he gives her to the Widow Mackey to rear. Learning that the widow's mortgage soon is due to Digg's partner, Lafe Hinton, Sandy goes to rancher Jeff Kirby for a job, but is mistaken for desperado Slim Dillon, and captured by Kirby's daughter Molly. After Sandy proves his innocence, he masquerades as Dillon and robs a stagecoach to help the widow. Sandy wins the mortgage money playing poker with Hinton. Kirby hires Sandy to stop the thieves rustling his prize steers. Sandy suspects Diggs and Hinton, and after he rescues Molly from Diggs, he finds a letter from a packing firm which proves his suspicions. Diggs recaptures Molly, and Sandy, pursuing, falls into Diggs' trap. As Diggs prepares to brand Sandy's bare back, Molly's pleas give Sandy the opportunity to pry loose. After capturing Diggs, Sandy, who loves Molly but thinks that she loves another, says goodbye. Molly then takes his revolvers and orders him to put his hands up and around her.

title: Boss! U Almost Got Her
description: When childhood sweethearts arrange to reunite at a bridal shop after twenty years apart, a manipulative best friend steals the bride's place and her billionaire groom. Now working as his secretary, the real bride must navigate growing feelings for her boss while unaware he's her long-lost love - even as her friend rushes them toward a wedding built on lies.

title: U Turn
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

description: It's the night of the premiere of the play The Case of Bertold B. Applause breaks through the hall. Then silence. And then screams and panic. Svetlana Sorga, an inspector who has to solve a mystery, enters the scene.

title: Ne v svoey tarelke
description: Only Igor knows the truth about the alien guests. But Sergey Petrovich also senses that something is wrong in the village, so he begins an investigation. No one believes him, because the newcomers have unexpectedly quickly integrated into village life: Igor has met those who will help raise the village, Father Agafon has met someone to guide on the true path, the teacher Ira has found a kindred spirit in the optimist Roma, and the saleswoman Lyuba has found a hero in the form of the interplanetary protector Borya. While Sveta, Borya and Roma's mother, is repairing the ship, the whole family lives in human shells. But hiding the truth is becoming more difficult due to strange events around, including beavers who have begun to talk thanks to an alien substance that has fallen into the river.

title: Generation W
description: Génération W, c'est une compétition où les équipes, flanquées de leurs supporters et de leur 'coach', peuvent se mesurer entre elles. On met chaque équipe au défi: on teste leur habilité à manier la manette, leur enthousiasme, leur débrouillardise et leurs connaissances. Mais c'est aussi des trucs pour mieux manoeuvrer dans l'univers des jeux, des cédéroms et de l'Internet; de nouvelles capsules anecdotiques où on découvre la petite histoire des jeux et des nouvelles technologies, une rubrique où on partage nos coups de coeur en matière de produits multimédia - mais où on se permet aussi de donner des coups de pied et de renvoyer les concepteurs à leur table à dessin; des reportages où on découvre des créateurs et des technologies à la sauce GW et un quizz où on jour le tout pour le tout pour mieux s'assurer la victoire.

title: Troche w ciazy
description: The story of the relationship between the energetic and resourceful Gosia and the lazy and slightly reckless Wojtek, whose relationship is put to the test. They are going through a deep crisis. It may turn out that the help of Wojtek's colleague, resolute but childish Tadek, will change the fate of these two.

title: Wycieczka w nieznane
description: Shooting a film on location in Oswiecim makes a young writer see the emptiness of his carefree existence.

title: W no higeki
description: Young college student Shizuka is given the opportunity to act in a stage play with professionals. Shizuka is willing to go to great lengths to master this role of a lifetime, but as the plot unfolds, she realizes that real life events are beginning to parallel events in the play.

title: Sweet Games
description: The campus belle An Ran pretended to be a "winner" to gain investment, but she was exposed in front of other people. She got drunk and accidentally had a one-night love with her younger landlord Yan Yue.

title: Skapani w ogniu
description: The first days in the so-called Recovered Lands abound in conflicts between the local Silesians and the immigrants. Former resistance fighter Captain Sowinski tries hard to reduce the tensions.

title: Hela w opalach
description: Hela is a recovering alcoholic, now divorced from an abusive husband, struggling to bring up three children on her own. This is a Polish version of American sit-com "Grace Under Fire", it's title in English means "Hela out on a llimb."

title: Rozmowy w toku
description: A talk-show in which people share their unusual life stories. Episodes range from less serious to serious or even taboo topics.

title: Ana w Hoa w Hya
description: The play revolves around Hamdi, a lawyer, who falls in love with a Nadia who he meets during a trip to Fayoum. However, due to a misunderstanding, he believes she is the wife of a thug who is searching for her and vowing to kill her. The events escalate through a series of comical situations.

title: Ghasil W Libis
description: The irony of politics and the social reality in Iraq performed in comedic sketches through each episode.

title: W Ltaayna
description: Glory and Hala is a love story that takes place in our current era, arising between the son of one of the ministers of corruption Majd, and Princess Hala, the daughter of Prince Omar Kabbara, who was known for his patriotism and his struggle against antiquities dealers, to end up being accused of a corruption case. It was fabricated for him by the mafia because of the files in his possession that incriminate them.

title: Tiger Mask W S1-S3
description: Two young wrestlers have the same goal; destroy the Tiger's Cave. One tiger walks the path of light, while the other walks the path of darkness.

title: W. - The Killer of Flanders Fields
description: Witse returns to his hometown to find his niece's murderer. It doesn't take long before Witse gets in trouble with local police authorities. While conducting his investigation, old family issues are starting to surface.

title: The W
description: When a man starts seeing bizarre apparitions through his window, he must navigate a series of hilarious and terrifying encounters that blur the line between reality and the supernatural in this comedic horror short.

title: Dancing in the Corner
description: After the fall of communism in 1989, color TVs were no longer a luxury good in Poland. The screens in many Polish homes are beginning to look more like the reality outside the window. But is reality truly colorful?

title: Saber w Rady
description: As the paralyzed businessman named Rady decides to hire a caretaker to look after him, Saber applies for the job, and they get into many comedic situations.

title: W Significa Guerra
description: Beware of Nosfero's army - they worship strength and have no mercy for the weak. His dangerous cult begins a wave of terror through the wasteland. In their way is Sgt. W2 of the special police forces.

title: Ana w Hiyya W Haya
description: Ana w Hiyya W Haya

title: Walad w Bent
description: A romance full of emotions, adventure and humor, the love of a lifetime is what the film is about. But between this boy and girl the story is not that simple. Although their bond is unbreakable they keep separating over the years. It's not circumstantial forces or even external pressures, but the very individuality of each is what keeps getting in the way in spite of all the love that's cherished within. In tracking their early zigzagged path the film delves into the complex and intricate web of inner conflicts that arise between young men and women of this age and ultimately innovatively poses the eternal question: Can Adam and Eve live happily ever after ?

title: W Ana Ahebak Baad
description: A light comedy that tackles the marital conflicts that arise over time, through the story of the couple, Khaled and Laura, who have many disagreements. With the help of Mona, Laura monitors Khaled all the time, believing that he is cheating on her.

title: W Kol Ma Neftreq
description: The tale of Nour, whose husband Hussam's family decides to get rid of her after she learns their secrets. But as Nour returns to life, she begins to look for her kidnapped daughter and plan revenge on Hussam's family.

title: Happiness [Hindi]
description: An apocalyptic thriller that takes place in a time in which infectious diseases have become the new normal.

title: W. What remains of the lie
description: A 50 year-old man -adopted - at the age of five- has no knowledge of his previous history. he thinks that he was born as a Jew in a concentration camp. The people close to Bruno, react with astonishment. In 1998, Bruno meets the Jewish journalist Daniel G, After only 10 minutes, Ganzfried gets that there is something wrong with the story. Today, 17 years after the scandal, Bruno lives a isolated life. The film will nevertheless, or perhaps, describe an aspect of Swiss mentality that refuses to face up to the truth and which suffers under its own insignificance.

title: Droga w swietle ksiezyca
description: The story is set in 1830s, shortly after the November Uprising in Poland. Julian, a young man with artistic interests, comes back home from abroad, where he studied history of art and anatomy. He wants to visit his father and meet his new wife, Katarzyna. Julian's mother died 6 years ago and although her husband promised her that he will never get married again, he broke this oath. The woman's ghost has not abandoned the house and is waiting for the punishment for her unfaithful spouse. It also influences Julian, who falls for his attractive stepmother. The doomed events constantly lead to a tragedy, which is about to happen...

title: W gli sposi
description: W Gli Sposi (Just Married) is a romantic comedy set both in Italy and the United States. The story follows the adventures of Maria, an aristocratic Italian woman who, together with her brother-in-law, travels from Milan to a small rural town in Georgia for her son's wedding. She will find herself in a reality made of people who work the fields and live a simple life. The plot develops through a series of funny situations with the villagers and the future mother-in-law, a strong woman who runs an Italian restaurant. Will love prevail in the end?

title: Burn Up W [English]
description: Team Warrior is a band of highly-skilled and completely crazy female cops. Featuring loose cannon Rio, trigger happy Maya and ace hacker Lilica, Team Warrior will get the job done, regardless of the budget of the mission.

title: X - Epoch of Dragon
description: Xin Yun is a loser in all the lives he was reborn into, always carefree instead of working hard. Recently reborn, he finds himself in the past and with the chance to change the course of the future. Follow Xin Yun's epic journey of self-cultivation to become the true hero of his story.

title: X-Gen
description: A fable about Generation X. When the flannel, grunge rock, dark beer, and cigarettes of Kirk's urban world collide with the minivans, boy band pop, and khakis of his old friends' new suburban life-- something has to SNAP.

title: X
description: Hafiz is a guy who always believe in love, but he's a loosed in love. In his early teenage years, he was being caught in close-proximity with a boyish girl. After Hafiz mother saw how Hafiz and his wife wooing a girl together, their relationship got into trouble. Hafiz divorced his first wife and let his parents find him his second wife. His second marriage was with someone who was too strict, so he divorced her too. Until Hafiz met his true love, all his ex-wives worked together to revoke his next marriage. Until one day his ex-wives realized that Hafiz really need a wife who understand and love him sincerely.

title: X-Machines
description: Features the most amazing machines on the planet taking on the most incredible engineering challenges.

title: Y [Hindi]
description: Some unexpected events on a street catch everybody present there by surprise. The movie is about how the characters there, react to the incidents taking place.

title: Y
description: When a film director is on the lookout for a script, an aspiring writer approaches him with a crime story that changes their lives forever.

title: Pedro Y Pablo
description: Two inseparable brothers tragically lose their parents and quickly find themselves in a constant struggle to survive. With little food to eat and bills soaring, Pedro, the oldest, makes the difficult decision to cross the border illegally to find a better job so that his brother does not have to interrupt his education. Pedro makes the dangerous journey and soon finds work as a servant to a wealthy family. While separated, the siblings face various challenges and eventually a romantic love affair. But will romance keep the siblings apart indefinitely? Will Pedro return to town and leave behind the new life he found in the city?

title: Pleasure and Martyrdom
description: Delfina is an attractive 45-year-old who enjoys a good economic spend and shares her life with a faithful husband and a teenage daughter. Through an intimate friend, she meets Kamil, a supposed high-ranking businessman.

title: Tierra y cielo
description: Clara, determined to earn her living and be valued for herself, leaves his rich father's home, changes her name and takes a room. Copying paintings at el Prado she meets Juan, who is also hiding his identity, pursued under charge of murder.

title: X, Y & Z
description: After 3 years in a relationship with her now indifferent but well-off boyfriend X, a young girl named Y is ready to call it quits. X reacts by proposing marriage to Y in 3 months time. She desperately wants to leave her mother's house and accepts X's proposal. The next day Y meets Z at her "while I get married elementary school" job. As Z naively begins to court Y, a steamy affair quickly develops between them. Y's emotionally and financially desperate double-nature manifests itself when she is unable to choose between X and Z. As the wedding day approaches, true love and monetary security clash in modern day Latin America.

title: Platero y yo
description: After a long period of absence, living in large and anonymous cities, a poet, Juan, returns to the village of his birth, Moguer, there he finds happiness through; the friendship of a small donkey, Platero, a free spirited girl, Aguedilla, and recalling memories of his childhood.

title: Amigas y rivales
description: Jimena De la O, the daughter of the richest man in Mexico is a troubled teen along with her best friend Ofelia, the two despise others who are not at their socioeconomical level, and live a fast, wild life, but then comes Laura, a middle class girl that teaches them that money, and status isn't everything, then there's Nayeli, the cook at the De la O's residence that longs for Jimena's acceptance as a person, and into her group with big dreams of becoming a Hollywood star.

title: Alazán y enamorado
description: Ana trae su caballo de carreras 'de Lady Godiva' el rancho de su padre. El caballo se enamora de un semental propiedad de su vecino Licio. Una historia llena de aventura y un final sorprendente.

title: ¿Y si sí...?
description: Imitators, comedy actors, monologists, and even YouTubers and influencers are put together for numerous comedy sketches about common themes of all sorts.

title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
description: A woman is abandoned by her husband during their honeymoon, she stays alone in the hotel were she meets other guests and we get to know their stories.

title: 40 y 20
description: A comedy series about a divorced dad who likes younger women, and his son who likes older women.

title: Barro y diamantes
description: Para pagar los estudios de su novia, Leo Pérez ha trabajado sin descanso en obras y empleos temporales. Justo en ese momento, aparece Luna Garza, la poderosa CEO del Grupo Garza. Conmovida por la bondad y la sinceridad de Leo, decide casarse con él de inmediato…
