title: Hombre y tierra
description: Mauro Bosque was an adventurer, a survivalist, but most of all, he was a dreamer. Mauro spent his days exploring some of the most dangerous places in the world and sharing those adventures on his Internet reality show, HOMBRE Y TIERRA. In January of 2005 he sought out to explore the dense forests of Belize to search for a series of legendary caves which he believes were once home to a clan of historic Mayan warriors. While on that excursion, he was believed to have disappeared without a trace. What happened during that three day hike has remained a mystery until the recent discovery of classified footage stolen from a Belezian government office. This is the story of, THE WOODSMAN.

title: Cómicos y canciones
description: Viruta and Capulina are a reporter and a photographer, respectively, of a detective newspaper. Trying to obtain notoriety they interview a grim killer known as "El Tampico", but when he finds out that they are reporters he goes ballistic and in their escape they lose the pictures and the interview notes. Instead of getting a raise, they receive a punishment from there boss. Deceived, going out with their girlfriends they witness a bank robbery. The robbers capture and torture Viruta and Capulina, but in a confusion they manage to escape. So the robbers then kidnap the girlfriends so they can't testify against them.

title: The Adventures of Y
description: When the government finds out Big Boss is back in town and stealing garbage cans, they send in the only man right for the job, Y. Which begs the question why him? He's a bumbling middle aged idiot who still lives with his mom; but somehow gets the job done. The Adventures of Y is a silly throw back to the old comedies of yester-year, with a live action cartoon feel.

title: Secuestro y muerte
description: In 1970 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, former dictator Pedro Aramburu is kidnapped and interrogated by the newly born terrorist organization Montoneros.

title: Cain y Abel

title: Scott y Milá
description: After many years of life and cameras, overcoming a personal blip, Mercedes Milá is reborn on television. As never before, without filters and with laughter, brave and committed. At her side, her faithful and cheerful dog, Scott.

title: Crimen y castigo
description: An adaptation of Fiodor's Dostoievsky novel Crime and Punishment set in the XX Century Mexico. Ramón Bernal is a poor student in Mexico City that has abandoned his career when he receives a letter informing him that his sister will marry a rich man. Thinking she will marry for money instead of love and feeling guilty about this he murders an old usurer to steal her money. With feelings of guilt he gets severely ill while his friend and family don't suspect he got anything to do with the murder, but as the murder investigation moves along inspector Porfirio Marín suspects about the student. Ramón also meets Sonia, a prostitute, and fells in love with her, the girl will teach her about regret and atonement.

title: Vigilantes y ladrones
description: The search for a hidden treasure in a hotel basement.

title: Y/Our Music
description: Y/OUR MUSIC immerses itself in the world of Thai musical expressions, from traditional music to labor songs and classical pop to urban indie music, spanning different locales and generations. As nine musicians display their musical expression, the rural or urban environments that influenced their sound are also explored. The hands that play traditional instruments amid the red dust clouds, the work songs being hummed in front of grains awaiting harvest, and the indie music born out of concrete basements create a melodious ecosystem. The film creates a sensory journey through some of the sounds and environments that encapsulate the music, from the noisy polluted streets of Bangkok to the calm, arid fields of Isan. While inhabiting different worlds, the musicians are linked by the same passion to bring their artistic aspirations to the fore and survive outside the pop mainstream.

title: Ramona y los escarabajos
description: Ramona is a fat woman with too much weight and barely any luck, her universe seems to be collapsing after a series of unfortunate events. But everything will soon get better thanks to some magical beetles she finds in a Tarot café.

title: Salud, dinero y amor
description: Health, money and love...tells the life of Wicho Dominguez after El Premio Mayor ended.

title: Cuerpo y alma
description: Tried and true story of three young buddies thrust into danger (in this case, World War I aviation), some of whom come back, while some are less lucky. Films about WWI fliers had been spectacularly successful in the U.S. in the early 1930s, like "Wings," "Hell's Angels," and "Dawn Patrol." The Fox Studio evidently hoped this particular story, written by Furthman and others, had enough box office potential that Fox filmed it in 2 versions, the original English-speaking one (see under "Body and Soul" (1931)), and this Spanish-language "Cuerpo y alma" [literal translation of "Body and Soul"]. In the Spanish version the three fliers were played by Lewis (Farrell's role), Alcantara (Bogart), Nieto (Dillaway) and the two women by Custodio (Landi) and Soler (Loy). It's ironic that this Spanish version actually ran a half-hour longer than the original English one (99 min. vs. 70 min.), although it's the same story filmed in the same sets. Perhaps Fox was so disappointed with the English-speaking result that after completion the studio cut it down radically (to play on US screens as part of a double feature), while the Spanish version actually preserved intact the complete original story...? (Something similar did happen that same year to the English and Spanish versions of "Dracula.")

title: Lasa y Zabala
description: Lasa y Zabala case was the first action headed by GAL "antiterrorist group", in 1983. Two Spanish policeman, following the direct orders of the general Rodriguez Galindo, kidnapped two ETA terrorist members, Jose Antonio Lasa and José Ignacio Zabala. Both policeman took the terrorist to La Cumbre palace, in San Sebastian (Basque Country), where they were tortured and interrogated. Later, they kill both terrorists and buried them in the city of Alicante, being their bodies found on 1985.

title: Gastar y conquistar
description: Tras salir de prisión, Christian descubre que su exesposa robó su fortuna, se buscó un amante joven y lo dio por muerto. Una runa activa un 'Sistema de Reembolso x10'. Cada dólar que gasta en mujeres vuelve multiplicado por diez. Christian cambia las reglas, aplasta enemigos y conquista mujeres poderosas, pasando de exconvicto a rey del exceso.

title: Equí y n'otru tiempu
description: Between October 1937 and November 1952 hundreds of Republican supporters took to the mountains of Asturias with two main objectives: to save their lives, and to continue their armed resistance against Franco. Many of them would die in those mountains. This film is centered on filming the places in the present where the major figures of the Asturian Guerrilla Group were killed.

title: Allez-y, héros de livraison !
description: Tang Mu était autrefois un pilote de course professionnel, mais lorsque sa fille Rui Rui est tombée gravement malade et a dû faire face à d'énormes dépenses médicales, il a décidé d'abandonner sa carrière de pilote et de devenir chauffeur-livreur. Sa femme, accablée par la pression, a choisi de divorcer et s'est retrouvée avec l'ancien rival de Tang Mu, Jiang Shifeng. Alors que Tang Mu sombrait dans le désespoir, une mystérieuse femme nommée Jun Ruo est apparue et lui a donné une boîte de livraison magique qui a amélioré son efficacité au travail. À son insu, Jun Ruo et un extraterrestre nommé Bai Li sont venus sur Terre pour absorber l'énergie émotionnelle. Au fur et à mesure que la vérité se dévoile, Tang Mu décide de se défendre. Avec l'aide de Jun Ruo, il déjoue le complot, protège sa fille et sauve la Terre d'une crise imminente.

title: Celos, amor y Mercado Común
description: Pseudo-erotic comedy with jealousy as the main motive. The film follows the adventures of several couples in Spain in the early 70s, whose stories intermingle with the Almodóvar producing comic results in each case: Luis is an unfaithful husband to his wife Juana, Felipe is a plumber who seeks extra-spousal adventures to hidden from his wife, Rosario, who works as an assistant. Ramón is a pathological jealous whose obsession is that his girlfriend Charity confess the hypothetical adventures he had with other men before meeting him, Irene is a jealous wife of her husband, Carlos, whose professional life gives him numerous opportunities for infidelity, Domin he is a pimp who frequents the brothels of Madrid .

title: Caín, Abel y el otro
description: Three early twenties guys in Acapulco competing for women end up marooned on a desert island together.

title: Suspiros de España (y Portugal)
description: After the death of the abbot of a small convent the two monks who are left discover among the papers of the passed away abbot letters from the mother of one of them indicating that he is the natural son of a landowner in Extremadura. In order to claim the legacy of his friend the monk who has lived outside the convent for some time plans their voyage to the property of his father picking up on their way his daughter and lover. Once in Extremadura things look a little different to what the plans say.

title: Volvió rico y frío
description: Hace cinco años, la heredera Lena Harrington abandonó al pobre genio Adrian Cole sin mirar atrás. Ahora él es multimillonario y ella se ahoga en deudas. Cuando se reencuentran, él es su jefe y todos esperan su venganza. ¿Pero qué es lo que nadie sabe? La chica que le rompió el corazón... sigue siendo a la que nunca dejó ir.

title: Papelucho y el marciano
description: Largometraje animado producido en Chile, basado en la novela homónima de la escritora chilena Marcela Paz. La película fue realizada el año 2007, dirigida por Alejandro Rojas y protagonizada por Marina Huerta, en la voz de Papelucho, y Leyla Rangel, en la voz de Det. Todo comienza cuando Papelucho, un joven inquieto y con gran imaginacion, se encuentra cara a cara con un marciano con el cual forma una rápida amistad. Este amigo se mete al interior de Papelucho, lo que genera en la historia un constante conflicto interno entre ambos. Cuando su nuevo amigo se le une mágicamente, causando que actúe extrañamente frente a otros, Papelucho es forzado a tratar de devolver al marciano de vuelta a su hogar. Papelucho decide hacer una nave para viajar a Marte y llevar a Det de regreso. En un estado febril y de ensueño, Papelucho, es impulsado por un motor de retroimpulso, originado por un millar de pulgas que lo llevan en su nave espacial hasta Marte, donde al fin él y Det se separan.

title: [Doblado] Sangre y Cura
description: Javier Herrera, robado de niño y criado por un gran médico, se convierte en un prodigio. Para curar a su padre adoptivo, regresa a la República de Águila e ingresa a la Academia Médica Suprema. Allí, la familia Duarte intenta usarlo como reemplazo de su hijo falso. Javier lo humilla en público, expone la impostura y salva a un magnate de la Capital. Descubre que su madre fue asesinada por Jimena Valdés y Armando Duarte, y se venga. Cuando Armando, arrepentido, le ofrece la herencia, Javier la rechaza, obtiene la medicina que necesita y se marcha libre con Sofía Castillo.

title: Cuatro regalos y una despedida
description:
Yo era la consigliera principal de la familia Falcone. Su cerebro. Y hoy, estaba a punto de irme para siempre: entregando las cuentas de todos los negocios legales que manejaba y cortando mi último vínculo con ellos.
Mi protegido no lo entendía.
—Eres el futuro de esta familia, Aurelia. No puedes simplemente irte.
Negué con la cabeza y sonreí con amargura.
Ellos no lo sabían. Llevaba tres años casada en secreto con el Don, Vittorio Falcone. Creí que mi belleza, mi inteligencia y todo lo que había hecho por él bastarían para ganarme todo su amor.
Pero un ataque en los muelles, tres meses atrás, me mostró la verdad.
Recibí trece balazos. Necesitaba una cirugía de emergencia y, para ello, hacía falta la orden directa de Vittorio. Lo llamé más de una docena de veces. Cuando por fin contestó, solo escuché una voz suave y entrecortada al otro lado.
—Vittorio, todavía no hemos cortado mi pastel de cumpleaños. ¿Me tomas de la mano y lo cortamos juntos?
Esa voz...
Era la de mi mejor amiga, Carina, la mujer de la que Vittorio estuvo enamorado.
En la casa de seguridad, debilitada por la pérdida de sangre, yo misma me saqué una bala y ordené a uno de mis hombres que me llevara a una clínica de la familia.
Justo cuando iban a entrarme al quirófano, Vittorio irrumpió... cargando a Carina.
Se había torcido el tobillo.
Necesitaba un médico. De inmediato.
Mi cirujano fue obligado a atenderla. Los antibióticos llegaron demasiado tarde. La herida se infectó y luché por mi vida durante una semana.
Cuando desperté, miré mi teléfono.
Ni un solo mensaje.
Las lágrimas finalmente cayeron.
Entonces lo entendí.
Yo solo era la mujer con la que se había visto obligado a casarse después de que lo drogaran y terminara acostándose conmigo. Un escándalo que había que ocultar.
A él solo le importaban mi utilidad y su reputación.

title: Fulham 0 - 3 Manchester United (Feb-09-2019) Premier League Highlights
description: Paul Pogba scored twice as Manchester United extended their unbeaten start under Ole Gunnar Solskjaer to 11 games with a 3-0 win at Fulham that moved them into the top four.Pogba rifled United into the lead with a devastating near-post finish on 14 minutes before Anthony Martial got in on the act with a brilliant solo effort, reminiscent of Cristiano Ronaldo's strike at Craven Cottage in 2007.Fulham started brightly and could have taken the lead through Luciano Vietto and Andre Schurrle, but United's quickfire goals knocked the wind out of their sails, with Pogba adding a third from the penalty spot midway through the second half.

description: Suansoon and Ongsa are in a relationship, but an accident occurred when Ongsa rushed to celebrate Suansoon's birthday and also their anniversary. Wracked with guilt, Suansoon wishes to go back in time to prevent their relationship.

title: Apartment Zero
description: Set in modern-day Buenos Aires, the film centers around a relationship between two emotionally-crippled roommates. Adrian LeDuc is a lonely sociopath who is forced to rent out his insane mother's room because of poor ticket sales at his revival movie theater. Jack Carney, the new roommate, appears normal enough at first but it soon becomes apparent that he is hiding something. As their friendship develops, Adrian suppresses his suspicions that Jack might be the government mercenary turned serial killer who has been terrorizing the city. The other eccentric residents of the building begin to worry as Adrian shows increasing signs that his mother's insanity may be hereditary. The shocking climax of this twisted tale of deceit, perversion, and murder reveals the darker side of the human psyche.

title: Aldnoah.Zero [English] S1-S2
description: In 1972, an ancient alien hypergate was discovered on the surface of the moon. Using this technology, humanity began migrating to Mars and settling there. After settlers discovered additional advanced technology, the Vers Empire was founded, which claimed Mars and its secrets for themselves. Later, the Vers Empire declared war on Earth, and in 1999, a battle on the Moon's surface caused the hypergate to explode, shattering the Moon and scattering remnants into a debris belt around the planet. Cut off from Mars, the remnants of the Vers Empire established several massive orbital space stations within the debris belt and a ceasefire was established. 15 years later, in 2014, an attack on the Vers princess during a peace mission causes the Empire to launch a new attack on Earth, this time determined to conquer it once and for all.

description: An apocalyptic look at the possibility of an earthquake of magnitude 7 or greater striking the Tokyo area. Mirai, a middle school freshman girl who goes to Tokyo's artificial Odaiba Island for a robot exhibition with her brother Yutaka at the start of summer vacation. A powerful tremor emanates from an ocean trench, the famed Tokyo Tower and Rainbow Bridge crumble and fall, and the landscape of Tokyo changes in an instant. With the help of a motorcycle delivery woman named Mari who they meet on Odaiba, Mirai and Yutaka strive to head back to their Setagaya home in western Tokyo.

title: Nervo Craniano Zero
description: Bruna Bloch, a successful writer, hires her former boyfriend to experiment a creativity inducing brain chip called Melpomene(the Greek muse of tragedy). Before trying on herself, they use Cristi, a naive country girl, as guinea pig. The chip, installed on the elusive cranial nerve zero, shows results beyond expected. Cristi can no longer sleep, eat, smell nor can she die. What seemed to be a breakthrough in science becomes a horrific nightmare.

description: At the beginning of Tang Dynasty, the male protagonist Song Zhexiu misunderstood and believed that she had hurt his half sister Tang Xiner, tormenting her with all kinds of torture. Two years later, the two reunited again, but the female lead refused to mention the past and pretended to be strangers to the male lead. The male protagonist tried his best to get forgiveness from the female protagonist, and in the end, the two of them, who had gone through hardships, were happily together.

title: Living Legends 66-0
description: As the nation was gripped by the Watts riot and civil rights movement, An all-black basketball team in post-riot Compton, California was led by a white head coach called the John Wooden of high school basketball who transforms a team of athletes into living legends becoming the first team in California history to win 66 consecutive basketball games without a loss while becoming back-to-back undefeated State and National Champions. As National Champions they represented the city of Compton, the state of California and the nation. They faced racism and discrimination, and brutality on and off the court because of the color of their skin. 2019 marked the 50th anniversary of that historic accomplishment. Something that hasn't been done in over 50 years and may never be done again. The documentary Living Legends 66-0 tells the story of the longest winning record in California High School Basketball history, how it transformed the coaches and players lives and uplifted their communities. Those teams, players, and coaches became professional athletes, Hall of Fame coaches, college graduates, Olympians, teachers, veterans and elected officials but were left out of their rightful place in history.

title: World 1-1
description: World 1-1 is the first in a documentary series on the history of video games. This chapter is about Atari and how they created a new industry. It focuses on the business deals, the personalities of the pioneers, and the creations of the engineers. This documentary will be a combination of interviews, archival footage, and reflection that retells the story to a new generation that may not know the roots of their favorite hobby. World 1-1 will follow the early games before the arcade machine even existed. It will tell the story of how Atari created the games industry years before it should have happened and follow the lucky deals and unfortunate mistakes that almost destroyed the entire industry just as quickly as it was born. Atari was the fastest growing company in the United States at the time. It kickstarted Steve Jobs' career, as well as others. The world's first successful arcade machine was built there, along with the first popular home console. Atari and its engineers formed the games industry we know today. It's time to tell this story, from the words of the creators themselves.

title: Studio Sessions 3
description:
Two weeks ago was the debut episode of CCW: Studio Sessions! It was a wonderful night of action, emotion and passion. It was Trevor Straud's final night in City Championship Wrestling, and he ended up in two matches, the second of which was  a CCW Championship Match against Jay Abrams!

Then the next week on the second episode of Studio Sessions we saw Joseph Antonio Guerrero form a mentorship with Dean Grassi. The Abrams Army defeated the returning Ultra Divine. To cap off the night, Chris Moore defeated CCW Champion, Jay Abrams to capture the championship with the help of none other than long time rival, Jonathan Presley!

On THIS episode, episode 3 of Studio Sessions and it's a big one!

First we will see some clips from Last Week's Studio Sessions.

We get Alex Lynch's thoughts on Jonathan Presley's new relationship with Chris Moore!

Then from there, we'll hear from the new team of Joseph Antonio Guerrero and Dean Grassi.

The new team of Guerrero and Grassi will meet Abrams Army representatives, T'Shuk the Terrible and Ike Watts in a match up that will see the winning team challenge for the CCW Tag Team Championship later on in the same episode!

Speaking of the CCW Tag Team Champions, once the challengers are determined, we will hear from the Champions themselves, Evan Encore and Miles Montagne, Third Degree.

The Mysterious Movado who made his return to CCW following a lengthy absence from the CCW scene just two weeks agon on the debut episode of Studio Sessions. This week, he takes on the Golden Empire's Castro Young alongside, Midas G. King!

Midas G. King leads the "Golden Enforcer" H5 Harrison into battle against the Iraq native, Ali Muhammad. Will Ali Muhammad make a name for himself by defeating the former All Media and Tag Team Champion, H5 Harrison or will The Golden Enforcer make another example out of his opponent?

Paul Bowser makes an announcement concerning the CCW All Media Champion and the All Media Champion himself, Harley Rock!

"The Karate ADULT" Mason Gaida steps into the squared circle with the "Alpha Lykan" Alex Lynch for a singles match with great All Media Championship implications.

Former CCW Tag Team Champions, T'Shuk the Terrible and Ike Watts look to regain those belts when they take on Champions, Evan Encore and Miles Montagne, collectively known as Third Degree in a Tag Team Championship Match up! Are we looking at a successful defense or are we looking at the first ever, Two-Time CCW Tag Team Champions?

In your main event,  It's Chris Moore w/Jonathan Presley vs. King Kong Coleman for the CCW Heavyweight Championship! Will King Kong Coleman finally be able to capture the Heavyweight Championship or will the Maestro conduct another orchestral victory in his first Championship defense!?

title: Big Brother 7/7
description: -"Big Brother 7/7" brings you original, never-before-seen content from the celebrities' best moments in the house. Want more Big Brother Celebrity? Every night, VRAK offers you privileged access to what's happening in the house. From post-elimination discussions to exclusive weekend activities, see never-before-seen content, unedited.

title: 7 Lagos, 7 Vidas
description: Diagnosed with ALS a decade a go, Dabiz travels around Eastern Europe in a van to encourage others (different and alike) never to give up.

title: The Ark S1-S3
description: Follows the remaining crew of a spacecraft known as Ark One, who must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course and survive after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

title: 7 Years
description: Agboja is an ultra-modern story that illuminates the sacrifices that African women undertake, in the protection of their Children from evil forces. Its rich pseudo-modern setting clearly highlights the pain and the agony that the rich and powerful society people hide with their luxurious facade and content in the quietness and privacy of their homes. The theme of Agboja also revolves around the dark covenant that people make with forces of the occult during their dark periods. It's a must watch for everyone who knows the significance of the travails of womanhood. Agboja is a celebration of the eminence of the Most-High God, in timely intervention into the affairs of mankind.
